units.source_text: [\[7\]](#part1333.html#w7) 僧官的最高级为僧正（其中大僧正最高，僧正次之，权僧正又次之），

en.t: [7] The highest rank among Buddhist clerical officials was Sojo; among them, Daisojo was the highest, Sojo came next, and Gon no Sojo followed after that.

units.source_text: 其次为僧都（分大僧都、权大僧都、少僧都、权少僧都四级），

en.t: Next came Sozu, which was divided into four grades: Daisozu, Gon no Daisozu, Shosozu, and Gon no Shosozu.

units.source_text: 再下面是律师（分正、权二级），阿阇梨又在律师之下。

en.t: Below that was Risshi, divided into the regular and provisional grades, and Ajari ranked below Risshi.
